trial_court: Family Court, Sambalpur, C.P.Case No.87 of 2020
facts_of_case: The parties entered into marriage in 2011. The wife pleaded that she was deserted and given dowry worth Rs.6 lakh. She claimed financial assistance to the husband on different occasions. The husband started abusing her after demanding further dowry, leading to physical assault.

legal_principles.principle: A deserted wife may request transfer of the civil proceeding to a more convenient location.
legal_principles.held: The Petitioner-Wife is also having a small child of four years in her custody. In these premises, Sri Chand submitted that it is impossible on the part of the Wife to attend the Court at Sambalpur at the distance of 300 kilometers and thus prayed for transfer of the Civil Proceeding.

legal_principles.principle: A party's inability to conduct their case due to financial constraints may be considered in a request for transfer of the civil proceeding.
legal_principles.held: the Petitioner being deserted by the Husband since was residing with her parents at Kesinga in the district of Kalahandi, almost three hundred kilometers away Sambalpur where the litigation was initiated and for no income of the Petitioner, she became unable to conduct her case at Sambalpur

outcome.final_order: The Family Court at Bhawanipatna was directed to hear the case.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for transfer of case in Family Court
advising on divorce proceedings under Hindu Marriage Act, 1955
